title: Vehicles & More
description: This is a vehicle mod that adds numerous bikes and other vehicles.
body:
This is a mod that adds a variety of vehicles, including various mountain bikes, a motorcycle, and a mountain board.

The vehicles are:
- Enduro, The basic mountain bike, capable of riding at a moderate speed and jumping at a moderate height and length
- Dirt Jumper, Slower than the enduro, but can jump much higher and farther
- Cross-country, This bike is much faster than the enduro. At a cost of its high speed, it does not do a good job jumping
- e-MTB, This is the greatest bicycle of the mod currently, it has the speed of the Cross-country, and the jumping of the Dirt Jumper
- Motorcycle, This is the ultimate transportation vehicle, it is faster than the e-MTB, and it has a step height of 2, which means it can drive up two blocks
- Mountain Board, Like a skateboard and mountain bike in one! It has different jumping properties, a low but far jump. It can also ollie.

The two blocks are:
- Jump Pad, gives bikes a jump boost and distance boost, used for making jumps on trails
- Boost Pad, Like the Jump Pad, but only gives forward boost, this is used for dropoffs, or obstacles you don't want a jump for

You don't really _need_ FramedBlocks for the mod to work, but it is highly recommeded.

The registry name is "vehicles__more." 

This mod was made with MCreator!!!!
